Definition: from G3326 and G4762; to turn across, i.e. transmute or (figuratively) corrupt:--pervert, turn.
BiblicalUsage: Peter quotes Joel: the sun shall be turned into darkness before the day of the Lord. Paul uses the same word for men who would pervert the gospel of Christ. One turning is God's sign in the sky, the other is man's corruption of the good news.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gospel is not ours to turn: the sun turned to darkness is God's doing at His appointed day, but a perverted gospel is man's doing, and Paul says there is no other gospel to turn it into.
RelatedTopics: Truth; False Teaching; Day of the Lord
